_comments: Demotes MJ: AI Model Costs.PriceTypeID to descriptive-only.
Three vocabularies described one concept and the MANDATORY one was the one nothing read:
PriceTypeID is NOT NULL, editable in the generated form and cached on AIEngineBase, yet no
business logic prices, filters or branches on it — AIModelPriceUnitType carries the real
contract, and now names the measure through UsageTypeID. Adding AI Usage Types without
demoting this would leave a fourth vocabulary and lock the ambiguity in permanently.
NOT dropped: the column is NOT NULL and carried by 235 metadata rows, so dropping it is on
the Forbidden list in packages/OpenApp/PUBLISH_NO_BREAK_POLICY.md and would break every
historical EXEC spCreateAIModelCost. That policy's Deprecation section is the intended path.
IncludeInGeneratedForm = 0 is the step that actually ends the ambiguity — deprecating while
still rendering an editable dropdown beside the authoritative field documents the confusion
rather than stopping it. AutoUpdateDescription = 0 is what makes the text below survive the
next CodeGen pass, which would otherwise restore it from the column comment.

fields.Description: DEPRECATED — descriptive only; nothing prices, filters or branches on it. The authority on what a cost row measures is UnitTypeID -> AIModelPriceUnitType.UsageTypeID. Retained only so existing configurations still validate and historical spCreateAIModelCost calls keep working; do not populate it for new cost rows.
